"We looked okay, I would say but we didn't have enough pace really. I think Max and Charles were very quick clearly and we seemed a little step behind Kimi so yeah. I think that was more or less what we could do."
social:piasnews-social-bcd7d5c16a3b7a49:.zh: 问：总体而言，与 Ferrari 或许还有 Mercedes 相比，McLaren 的比赛表现还算不错？"我们看起来还行，我会这么说，但我们真的没有足够的速度。我觉得 Max 和 Charles 显然非常快，而我们似乎比 Kimi 稍逊一步，所以是的。我觉得这差不多就是我们能做的了。"

social:piasnews-social-475b0d0803fa4d5b:.source_text: Q: How satisfying was it to get that 5th? "Yeah I mean...it's for fifth place so there's a cap on the excitement but no certainly made it more exciting at the end which was good fun. Felt like it was a reasonable race. Obviously the puncture was a bit of a shame but I don't think it changed things too much so happy with that."
social:piasnews-social-475b0d0803fa4d5b:.zh: 问：拿到第5名有多满足？"是的，我是说……这是第五名，所以兴奋程度有限，但确实在最后让比赛更刺激了，这很有趣。感觉这是一场合理的比赛。显然爆胎有点可惜，但我不认为它改变了太多，所以对此很满意。"

I think the start is really the biggest place you can make a difference so hopefully if it's wet, we can make a good start and go from there!" https://t.co/izvSrbCvub
social:piasnews-social-3afe2c60051e7f26:.zh: 问：如果下雨，你觉得那能让你进入竞争行列吗？"我希望那能让我们进入竞争行列，是的。我觉得起步真的是你能做出最大差别的地方，所以希望如果下雨，我们能有一个好的起步，然后从那里开始！"

social:piasnews-social-030b9f8e5a199679:.source_text: Q: What do you think you can do from where you're starting? "Uh we'll wait and see. We'll see what the weather does as well.
